title: VIA UI input-status-output contract
purpose: Bind UI controls to governed parameters, status telemetry, data subjects, units and outputs without embedding business logic in the view.

steps.action: Map each UI input to a typed registry parameter and default value.
Expose input, running status, validation and output as separate UI states.
Preserve VAP visual locks and responsive panel behavior.
Verify subject, unit, data type and source are visible or machine-addressable.
